title: SeungYong Oh
text: I am a veterinarian and Ph.D. student at Seoul National University, working at the intersection of statistics and biomedicine. My current research focuses on single-nucleus RNA sequencing analysis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
